name: IEC pushbutton contact: normally closed push button positive break
aliases: pushbutton contact Normally Closed Push Button Positive Break
summary: Pushbutton contact form: Normally Closed Push Button Positive Break.
description: A pushbutton translates a person pressing an operator into a change of electrical contact state. The operator form and the contact state are separate pieces of information, so a mushroom head can operate either a normally-open or a normally-closed contact. This entry identifies the normally closed push button positive break form in the publisher's IEC-context family.

On a machine control sheet, this form lets the reader distinguish the physical button action from the contact used by the controller. Link every contact block to the same operator tag, including a separate indication lamp when fitted. The normally-closed designation starts with a conducting output or closed contact in the documented reference condition; operation changes that state. The positive-break qualifier identifies direct mechanical opening intent. Confirm the selected contact assembly and manufacturer declaration before relying on that property.

The head shape and contact drawing do not establish a safety category, contact rating or emergency-stop suitability. Direct opening, reset behaviour and the selected assembly must be confirmed from its documentation.
